description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class 'ImmutableAddressMetric' which models address metrics with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities within a connectivity context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableAddressMetric
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the AddressMetric interface that holds a set of Measurements and supports JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableAddressMetric instance from a set of measurements.

methods.name: getMeasurements
methods.description: Returns the set of measurements associated with this address metric.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the address metric to a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate filters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an AddressMetric object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks value equality based on the measurements set.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on measurements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: toJsonField
methods.description: Converts an AddressMetric into a JSON field given a key.
